values.note: Rates effective April 2025, 4 people: water & electric (rows D-H) $44 a night, 30-amp full hook-up (row C) $49, 50-amp full hook-up (rows A-B) $54; primitive overflow sites $30. Extra people $5 (19+) / $2 (5-18) a day. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) carry a one-time $5 charge per site. Weekly, monthly and seasonal rates too. The fall 2026 home page offers $5 off per night.

note: Private family campground near Houghton Lake, Michigan's largest inland lake, with cabins and a primitive tent area beside the camper sites; heated pool, coffee shop, game room. A Christian, family-oriented park that does not tolerate rowdy behavior, drunkenness or loud music. --Claude
summary: Operator site live, phone (989) 422-3931 matches. Confirmed the April-2025 rates already stored ($44 W&E to $54 50-amp FHU, now manual with the rate rows and holiday charge in fees.note); added 50-amp/water/sewer, all pull-through, showers/laundry/store/wifi, April-October season (closes Oct 19 in 2026), phone-only reservations from one year out.
